original_metadata.title: Strict dominance ordering and unique minimal-energy multiplets at fixed particle number for finite open SU(N) extended Hubbard chains with N at least three, positive hopping, exchange and pair hopping, and real number-dependent potential
original_metadata.author: Tigran Hakobyan
original_metadata.source_title: Ordering of Energy Levels for Extended SU(N) Hubbard Chain
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: Perron-Frobenius positivity alone does not identify which irreducible flavor representation contains a many-fermion sector minimum. The author constructs a fermionic sign basis for hopping, exchange and pair hopping, and a compact trial configuration whose row symmetrization and column antisymmetrization isolate one Young type. Positive overlap and uniqueness then identify the relative ground multiplet, and a shared-weight comparison proves strict energy ordering under diagram dominance.

proof_review.note: Read exact finite open-chain Hamiltonian(1) and its positive t_x,J_x,K_x assumptions2, the nonpositive flavor-grouped fermion basis3-4, complete weight-sector connectivity/positivity and compact Young-tableau trial-state identification5-6, and full dominance/multiplet argument6-7. Select the two Section5 summary assertions as one same-core main result: at fixed total M, realized Young diagrams with at most N rows and first row<=L have a unique lowest multiplet and E(Y2)>E(Y1) for strict dominance Y2>Y1. Restrict N>=3 and the scalar occupation-number potential V to real values. Perron-Frobenius and the precise unitary-group weight/Young symmetrizer facts are named published foundations and explained here; they are not omitted local new cores. Source scalar completeness/diagonal terms(3) use lowercase n although the flavor count is N. Preserve that display: the proof explicitly absorbs all occupation-number diagonal terms into arbitrary V and uses the supplied off-diagonal flavor-exchange sign basis, so no replacement scalar coefficient is introduced. Ground-state antisymmetric-multiplet consequence8 and continuous-space fermion/Schur-Weyl discussion9-11 are uncounted; no periodic chain claim. Exact selected statement and terminal proof pages rendered and visually inspected; physical headers/native ZIP members and source/license hashes checked. No independent mathematical reproof.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Finite open chain with L sites and N>=3 fermion flavors, the exact Hamiltonian(1), all t_x,J_x,K_x>0 and arbitrary real V(n_1,...,n_L). Fix total particle number M. For each realized U(N) Young type Y with M boxes, at most N rows and first row<=L, its sector minimum consists of one irreducible multiplet (ordinary SU(N) dimension degeneracy allowed). If two such diagrams satisfy strict dominance Y2>Y1, then E(Y2)>E(Y1). No ordering across different M or incomparable diagrams, and no periodic-boundary extension.
original_metadata.editorial_warning: Original scalar completeness/diagonal displays use lowercase n where the flavor count is denoted N elsewhere. These occupation-number diagonal terms are explicitly absorbed into arbitrary V in the authored proof; the exact source Hamiltonian and all source formulas remain unchanged. Sector uniqueness means one multiplet, not a simple eigenvalue after discarding SU(N) degeneracy.
